en: Isma'il ibn Ali Imad al-Din Abu al-Fida
ar: إسماعيل بن علي عماد الدين أبو الفداء

description.tr: Coğrafya ansiklopedisi yüzlerce şehir için koordinatlar ve betimlemeler sağladı || Ebü'l-Fidâ hem hükümdar hem âlimdi. || [Tarih notu] Takvîm, Latince'ye çevrilen ilk Arapça coğrafya eserlerinden biriydi (1650).
description.en: His geographic encyclopedia provided coordinates and descriptions for hundreds of cities, and became a primary reference for European orientalists after Latin translation || Abu al-Fida was both a ruler and a scholar — a rare combination that gave him the resources and perspective to compile geographic and historical encyclopedias. || [Historiographical note] His Taqwim was one of the earliest Arabic geographic works translated into Latin (1650), shaping European understanding of the Islamic world's geography.
description.ar: وفرت موسوعته الجغرافية إحداثيات ووصفاً لمئات المدن || كان أبو الفداء حاكماً وعالماً في آن واحد
